sections.description: You do not need a finished specification. A few useful starting points make the first conversation more productive.
items: Your offer, audience and business objective
Your planned media budget and priorities

items.question: Is advertising spend included in service fees?
items.answer: Media spend and service work should be agreed separately in the proposal. Confirm platform budgets, billing and ownership before launching a campaign.

items.question: Can you guarantee rankings or leads?
items.answer: No specific outcome can be guaranteed. Results depend on the market, budget, execution and other factors. The scope should define the work and the measures used to review it.

items.question: How will we review performance?
items.answer: Agree the objectives, reporting cadence and available data at the start. Reports should explain what happened, the limits of the data and possible next actions.

items.question: How do you estimate timing and fees?
items.answer: The team will review your brief, available materials and deliverables before sharing a project-specific estimate. Changes in scope can affect both timing and cost.
